summary: Build CUSTOMER_MASTER from customer and transaction sources
description:
Business objective
Build the CUSTOMER_MASTER target from the customers source (CUSTOMER_SOURCE) and the transactions source (TRANSACTION_SOURCE) so Finance can report net revenue per customer.

Acceptance Criteria
AC1: CUSTOMER_ID is the business key of CUSTOMER_MASTER. CUSTOMER_ID must be unique and cannot be null.
AC2: CUSTOMER_NAME = UPPER(TRIM(customers.CUSTOMER_NAME)).
AC3: SEGMENT is copied as-is from customers.SEGMENT.
AC4: Only transactions with STATUS = 'COMPLETED' are included.
AC5: NET_AMOUNT = SUM(AMOUNT - DISCOUNT) per CUSTOMER_ID, rounded to 2 decimals.
AC6: TXN_COUNT = COUNT(TXN_ID) of included transactions per CUSTOMER_ID.
AC7: Every customer appears in CUSTOMER_MASTER: LEFT JOIN customers to transactions on CUSTOMER_ID. Customers without included transactions get NET_AMOUNT = 0 and TXN_COUNT = 0.
